meta.title: CH Lucky Global — Licensed Wolt Delivery Partner in Kosovo
meta.description: CH Lucky Global is a licensed courier company and official Wolt delivery partner in Prishtina, Kosovo. Apply as a courier or contact us today.

hero.title: Kosovo's Trusted Wolt Delivery Partner
hero.subtitle: A licensed courier services company built on pride, respect, and responsibility.

about.title: Who We Are
about.p1: CH Lucky Global is a licensed courier services company operating in Kosovo, serving as an official Wolt delivery partner agency. We operate on the principles of pride, respect, and responsibility in everything we do.
about.p2: Headquartered in Prishtina, our team is committed to full legal compliance, road safety, and customer satisfaction in every single delivery. We invest in our couriers so that every order arrives with care and professionalism.
about.point_1: Fully licensed and legally registered in Kosovo
about.point_4: Commitment to safety and full legal compliance

vision.title: Where We're Headed
vision.vision_text: To be Kosovo's most trusted and respected courier service provider, raising the standard of quality, discipline, and professionalism in every delivery.
vision.mission_text: To deliver a fast, safe, and respectful experience to every customer through the Wolt platform, by investing in the training, safety, and wellbeing of our couriers.

principles.title: The Values That Guide Us
principles.subtitle: Pride, Respect, Responsibility — the foundation of everything we do.

items.title: Respect for Kosovo and Its People
items.text: We respect the country we live in and the people of Kosovo.

items.title: Legal and Official Documents
items.text: All our documents must be legal, valid, and up to date.

items.title: Traffic Rules and Respectful Drivers
items.text: Our couriers obey traffic rules and show respect on the road.

items.title: Respectful Customer Communication
items.text: We communicate with our customers in a polite, professional, and friendly way.

items.title: Personal Care and Professionalism
items.text: We pay attention to personal hygiene, appearance, and professional attitude.

items.title: Representing Our Country with Pride
items.text: We represent our country in the best way through our behavior and work ethic.

gallery.title: Our Team in Action
gallery.subtitle: A look at our couriers and daily operations in Prishtina.
